<answer_open_question>
Q1: Exceeding the entitlement can still be submitted. Date window is a hard block
Q2:  a request that is not confirmed or approved by the end of the month of the leave start date will be cancelled. A request for a later month can be review at the end of that month, no need to review before that month starts
Q3: User can select which PM to confirm their request.
Q4: All that data come from an existing HR system.
Q5: Users sign in by the company's single sign-on
Q6: File format for entitlement import can be decided by you. Annual refresh will be the new baseline for requests still pending. The system calculate seniority-based entitlement. Rules don't differ per country.
Q7: Leave request is calculated in half days, which mean there. are 3 options: All day, morning, and afternoon.
Q8: Employee can cancel leave request, as long as the request hasn't been approved by line manager yet.
Q9: A line manager don't have to submit a leave request. A line manager is the one managing the Business Unit, not at project level, so they can never be a PM
Q10: Admin and HR are one role only, not two. Manager can only see report from their own unit
Q11: Period is the last week. Valid leave request means any submitted request
Q12: Data come from an external system
Q13: Mail service is not defined yet. Submission should sent email to PM, confirmation should send to Line Manager, denial, approval, rejection should send to the employee who submit the request
Q14: English only
</answer_open_question>
